summary: Read the stale-heartbeat receipt (0d7287723fda4a8e8ecf3553990c6dbf, exit 0, test passed) and found all three comparisons complete and holding, so the refutation of @q_stale_heartbeat_stepdown is now receipt-backed rather than source-only: the current leader stayed Leader at term 3 with persisted term 3, answered the stale heartbeat with its own term, and left the third voter's leader view unchanged, while the premise (stale leader at term 2 with the payload built exactly as the heartbeat goroutine builds it) was recorded. The interpretation is updated to cite that receipt and to keep its limits (AppendEntries only, one cluster size, one delivery time; equal-term delivery to a non-follower still performs the transition by design; the fast-path concurrency question is bounded by which fields a pure heartbeat touches, not by a race-detector run). With all four registered questions now carrying decided accounts, this turn also promotes the two decided-but-only-interpreted effects into durable knowledge with their receipts: the replayed leadership-transfer message and its measured cost (term 3 -> 4 with the same node re-elected, one leaderless sample in 138, one refused client write in 138 attempts within a sub-10 ms window) and the configuration-change block with its wedge (phantom removal committed in 0 ms, consistent-follower removal did not commit within 5001 ms, follow-up removal refused with a 1000 ms enqueue timeout). No experiment was requested this turn; the remaining unmeasured scope is larger clusters, production-style monotonic stores, delayed rather than duplicated transfer delivery, and partitions during replay.
